text:
alex-r: FYI PR #6821 – private installer docs: network checklist + HSM PKCS11 example. Need quick triage before merge. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6821

maya: skimmed. two issues I noticed quickly — (1) iptables vs nftables note is ambiguous for newer distros; (2) PKCS11 example hardcodes an x86 path. we should show a detection fallback.

sam: agree. I'd like a tiny conn-checker (one-shot) that validates DNS, MTU, and TLS handshake to KMS endpoint. keep it zero-deps so it works in airgapped minimal images.

megan-s: I can add JS + Go SDK snippets demonstrating KMS token auth in an airgapped setup (reading token from file + explicit CA bundle). will push to branch.

alex-r: perfect. can someone take the iptables/nftables clarification and add a small OS compatibility table? we need to avoid saying \"iptables recommended\" — be prescriptive only when necessary.

infra-max: I'll take the OS matrix. quick note: we should call out vendor PKCS11 libs (Yubico/Thales/CloudHSM) and show env var example: 
export PKCS11_LIB=/usr/lib/libykcs11.so
Add a short sentence on permission bits for /dev/tty* and group membership for pkcs11.

maya: suggestion for fallback snippet that detects lib path: 
```
if [ -f /usr/lib/libykcs11.so ]; then
  export PKCS11_LIB=/usr/lib/libykcs11.so
elif [ -f /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/opensc-pkcs11.so ]; then
  export PKCS11_LIB=/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/opensc-pkcs11.so
fi
```
This helps on Debian/Ubuntu vs RHEL/CentOS. mention SUSE differences too.

sam: for the conn-checker I'm thinking systemd one-shot: /etc/systemd/system/rw-conn-check.service that runs /usr/local/bin/rw-conn-check.sh. sample of the core check (bash):
```
#!/bin/bash
set -e
# DNS
host ${1:-docs.redwood.local} >/dev/null || { echo \"DNS fail\"; exit 2; }
# MTU
ip link show | grep mtu >/dev/null || echo \"mtu lookup ok\"
# TLS handshake
echo | openssl s_client -connect ${2:-kms.example:443} -CAfile /etc/rw/ca.pem >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo \"TLS fail\"; exit 3; }
echo \"conn-check OK\"
```
Keep it minimal so it can run in airgapped nodes.

docs-bot: Preview deploy for PR #6821 is live: https://deploy.preview/docs/pull/6821 :white_check_mark: CI: docs-build (linux/amd64) passed.

megan-s: small link fix — the internal link to the airgap mirror guide 404s. should point to /docs/airgap/mirror-setup.md (not /docs/airgap/mirror.md). I'll update the markdown and add a redirect note in the TOC.

alex-r: assign reviewers: maya + infra-max. megan will own the SDK snippets. sam will add the conn-checker. ETA: EOD today for branch updates?

maya: EOD works for me but ask infra-max to validate on SUSE & Ubuntu 22.04 (we've seen lib path differences there).

infra-max: will validate on SUSE, Ubuntu 22.04, and Ubuntu 20.04. Also adding a concise firewall port list to the network checklist: 
- egress TCP 443 to KMS endpoints (required)
- ephemeral outbound (1024-65535) for client connections
- optional: UDP 123 for NTP/chrony if time sync is required
We should not recommend opening etcd/2379 unless customer runs internal etcd.

sam: I'll include a troubleshooting snippet (table in docs) covering: DNS resolution, MTU mismatches (symptoms: token handshake failure at x bytes), time skew (NTPS mismatch), PKCS11 permission errors (strace shows EACCES).

megan-s: SDK snippets pushed to branch 'docs/sdk-kms-airgap' — commit abc123def. includes JS example that loads token from /var/run/rw/kms.token and uses custom CA: 
```
const fs = require('fs');
const ca = fs.readFileSync('/etc/rw/ca.pem');
const token = fs.readFileSync('/var/run/rw/kms.token', 'utf8').trim();
const client = new KMSClient({ baseURL: 'https://kms.internal', ca, token });
const res = await client.decrypt({ ciphertext: '...' });
```
Go snippet uses tls.Config{RootCAs: pool} and reads token similarly.

alex-r: awesome. once you push the conn-checker + OS matrix + link fix, re-request review. if CI preview looks good, we'll merge and cut a tiny docs patch release (no product rollout).

infra-max: added a short note about HSM vendor capabilities (slot enumeration differences + recommended read timeouts). put it under 'HSM integration notes' in the private/install guide.

sam: conn-checker PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6835 — includes systemd unit, script, and small README.

maya: reviewed the conn-checker, left one nit about exit codes. otherwise looks good.

megan-s: updated the internal link and rebased sdk branch onto main. build preview updated.

alex-r: thanks everyone. plan: merge once all approvals in and preview passes. quick post-merge checklist: add changelog entry, update TOC, ping #customer-success for heads-up. :shipit:

alex-r: closing the triage thread — reopening if any blockers crop up.
